title: Refined and Quiet Driving Experience
summary: Reviews in this topic consistently praise the F70 for feeling refined, quiet, comfortable, and pleasant to drive, with some mentions of strong performance and improved tech.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe a refined and quiet ride with comfortable cruising, enjoyable driving, and occasional mentions of performance, better tech, and apparent reliability.

limitations: The sample is small and sentiment-stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all F70 reviews.
One fragment mentions reliability only as 'so far reliable', which is limited evidence for that specific aspect.
